markdown: ## Low-Latency Dispatch ## Reserving Slots with Atomics A partition belongs to one source rank. slot = atomicAdd(&reserve[e], 1); peer = e / 9; local_e = e % 9; put_nbi(remote[local_e][rank][slot], staged_token, peer); Each concurrent sender receives a different slot. • One atomic increment allocates a unique slot among local sends to the same expert. Source-rank slices separate GPUs; the atomic separates concurrent warps on one GPU.
